target: Metal Gear Solid V: The Phantom Pain
purpose: Bounded map of source-backed native state, inventory, and control families for offline scenario planning.
claim_rules: An exposed inventory ID or input packet proves observability or delivery only; it does not prove an in-game action succeeded.
A candidate exercise is not a pass until the native before/after fields show the requested state and restoration.
Weapon variants and upgrades are grouped by family; this catalog does not count untested variants as coverage.

loadout_positions.definition: 3 primary/secondary weapon positions + 8 support-weapon positions + 8 item positions.
loadout_positions.current_observer_coverage: The observer now emits a named query for all 19 positions. A missing API/entry is serialized as unavailable; an empty slot is the game's numeric EQP_None value. Field presence is not proof that any item is selectable or usable.

equipment_taxonomy.definition: Eight developed weapon families plus enemy weapon, support weapon, and equipment groups in the retail debug taxonomy. This is a class denominator, not proof that each class is VR-tested.

state_families.definition: The explicit families tracked in this catalog; mission-specific actions and NPC states are outside this bounded denominator.
state_families.currently_observable_note: Four families directly expose named native status or inventory-ID readbacks: posture, carry, binocular status, and loadout inventory (now all 19 positions). Ammo counters, item cursor candidate, disable-action flag, and vehicle classifiers are also emitted as partial telemetry; none proves an action transition or test pass.

current_control_preset_evidence.tpp_readback: No current TPP control-preset or button-layout getter was found in the inspected owned Lua API surface. Pad.GetDeviceType() reports device family only; the inspected pad-config function receives padType as an argument rather than reading it back. TppPadOperatorUtility.lua exposes registration, masks, and stick-rate setters, not an assignment getter.
current_control_preset_evidence.read_only_candidate: Pad.GetDeviceType() may be recorded as controller-device metadata, but it cannot disambiguate the active TPP preset or button assignment.

nearest_owned_mapping_is_not_tpp_proof.detail: This Ground Zeroes-owned file routes PL_SUB_CAMERA to sysR1 and selects default/FPS and CQC-button variants via padType 0..3 and CqcButtonConfig. Its X360 branch leaves sysR1 as PAD_R1; PS3 remaps sysR1 to PAD_R2. The repository has no corresponding extracted TPP file, so this is adjacent evidence only and does not establish the user's installed TPP mapping.

vr_transport_boundary.detail: The VR native-button table maps right_grip to the Xbox right-shoulder bit 0x0200 in native-button mode. The gameplay foot route binds right_grip to gameplay.ready_weapon and disables gameplay.native_right_shoulder. This identifies the mod's effective input routes, not the TPP action assigned to that Xbox bit.

runtime_binding_policy: The route rows above are source defaults. Before using a route in a scenario, resolve its action ID against that run's effective binding export so user overrides or disabled routes are respected; see docs/NATIVE_CONTEXT_COVERAGE.json:12 and docs/NATIVE_CONTEXT_COVERAGE.md:7.

read_only_native_fields.notes: Use a single status value per field. STAND/SQUAT/CRAWL and CARRY are used by owned retail Lua. BINOCLE is queried by the current observer. NORMAL_ACTION and PARTS_ACTIVE are broad statuses, not precise aim/CQC/cover states.
Reports equipped inventory IDs only. These arrays do not identify which weapon/item is currently selected or held. Do not report empty slots as usable equipment.

read_only_native_fields.status: three core-slot arrays are now queried by WEAPONSLOT ID; selected-slot association remains unavailable
read_only_native_fields.notes: Could support before/after ammo deltas after indices are validated. A delta alone does not prove a reload animation or successful fire action.

read_only_native_fields.status: source-backed classifier fields are emitted; known-fixture behavior has not been sampled
read_only_native_fields.notes: Owned TPP scripts classify this variable as horse/helicopter/vehicle in mission and tutorial logic. It classifies the referenced vehicle object; it is not a camera-derived posture guess. Verify null-ID behavior before making false/true an acceptance predicate.

read_only_native_fields.status: source-backed guarded read-only field is emitted; preserves an unavailable result if the passenger table is not initialized
read_only_native_fields.notes: The helper accepts a name or object ID and checks the support-helicopter passenger table. Preserve nil as unavailable; do not equate an absent/stale table with false.

read_only_native_fields.status: device family only; no active control preset/button map readback found
raw value and constant are emitted; do not assume the flag is an aim/subject state or bitmask

Does not identify the carried actor or whether a safe drop/restore point exists.

state_coverage.observer: named fields query all 19 positions; per-entry availability is explicit
state_coverage.limit: Inventory presence does not prove selection, readiness, aim, fire, or reload.

state_coverage.observer: selected_weapon_slot is explicitly unavailable; item_cursor_candidate is emitted but not semantically validated
state_coverage.evidence_level: unsupported for weapon; candidate for item
state_coverage.limit: Retail scripts expose Player.SetCurrentSlot and set currentItemIndex to 0 during mission setup, but no read-only current weapon slot getter was found in the inspected Lua. The candidate cursor must not be treated as a selected item until validated.

state_coverage.observer: no validated native aim/ready state field; raw playerDisableActionFlag is emitted as separate metadata; no PlayerStatus.SUBJECT use was found in inspected TPP Lua
state_coverage.limit: gameplay.ready_weapon and controller aim are mod-side inputs/state, not proof that retail Snake is aiming or in a chosen optic mode. SUBJECTIVE_CAMERA is a PlayerDisableAction flag used to disable camera behavior, not an observed aim-state result.

state_coverage.observer: per-slot magazine/sub-ammo counters are emitted for three core weapon slots; no action result field
state_coverage.limit: Retail tutorial message handlers are events, not a persistent action outcome. Ammo deltas can be attributed only after selected-slot semantics are known; reload/fire may consume scarce ammunition.
The effective VR trigger route is fire_or_cqc; that route cannot distinguish a shot from CQC outcome. GZ's configurable CQC assignment is not TPP mapping evidence.
Do not infer cover from camera pose, posture, or NORMAL_ACTION.

state_coverage.observer: classifier fields emitted; known-fixture behavior not yet sampled
state_coverage.limit: A horse action context is not proof Snake is mounted.

state_coverage.observer: classifier fields emitted; known-fixture behavior not yet sampled
state_coverage.limit: Stryker-specific distinction is supported by the GZ-owned pad config only; don't promote it to current TPP acceptance.

state_coverage.observer: vehicle-type and support-helicopter passenger fields emitted; known-fixture behavior not yet sampled
state_coverage.limit: The passenger-table field is unavailable before initialization and covers the support-helicopter passenger table, not every airborne/mission camera state.

state_coverage.observer: inventory IDs emitted; cursor candidate emitted but semantics not validated

candidate_reversible_exercises.setup: Stable on-foot, non-demo, stationary mission state; record the initial posture.
candidate_reversible_exercises.exercise: Visit STAND, SQUAT, CRAWL, then return to the initial posture using the configured gameplay bindings.
candidate_reversible_exercises.pass_rule: Each requested PlayerStatus field changes to true with the others consistent, then the initial field returns true.
candidate_reversible_exercises.restore: Return to recorded initial posture and verify it in native status samples.
candidate_reversible_exercises.risk: Low when stationary; do not count a button press alone.

candidate_reversible_exercises.setup: Stationary on-foot state with no open menu; record status_BINOCLE=false.
candidate_reversible_exercises.exercise: Use the currently exported gameplay.equip_binoculars route; then use binoculars.stow.
candidate_reversible_exercises.pass_rule: status_BINOCLE becomes true after entry and false after stow; report controller/preset metadata separately.
candidate_reversible_exercises.risk: Low; the existing native-right-shoulder assay did not establish the TPP shoulder mapping.

candidate_reversible_exercises.setup: Read-only scenario-state poll before any control action.
candidate_reversible_exercises.exercise: Enumerate the 3 weapon, 8 support-weapon, and 8 item ID positions and preserve null/empty values.
candidate_reversible_exercises.pass_rule: All 19 positions parse as IDs or empty/unavailable without writing game state.
candidate_reversible_exercises.risk: None; counts inventory slots, not usable action coverage.

candidate_reversible_exercises.setup: Only when the game is already in a known safe mounted/ride state; do not initiate movement.
candidate_reversible_exercises.exercise: Read vars.playerVehicleGameObjectId and the Tpp.IsHorse/IsVehicle/IsHelicopter classifiers; preserve query errors/null distinctly.
candidate_reversible_exercises.pass_rule: Classifier agrees with an independently known fixture state and remains stable across two bounded read-only samples.
candidate_reversible_exercises.risk: None from the query; candidate classification is unverified until a live fixture.

observed_assay.result: The native-right-shoulder-binocle case failed its state deadline. Parent reports XInput right-shoulder mask 0x0200 was consumed for 1.4 seconds while 120 live status_BINOCLE samples stayed false.
observed_assay.interpretation: Input delivery did not produce the observed native BINOCLE state in that run. This does not identify whether the cause is the TPP button preset, route/context, in-game eligibility, or another precondition; it is not evidence that 0x0200 is the correct TPP action mapping.
do_not_count_as: proof of installed TPP right-shoulder assignment
proof that every binocular entry path is broken
